name: Yvet
source:
"It's okay. I'm not alone."

She was a member of The Web, an assassination organization, and worked under Lau Ka Tung, but she refused the order to kill Lai, killed Lau Ka Tung, and left The Web.
After leaving The Web, she was taken into the custody of Yeung Kwun, the head of the Red Flower Society, through Lai's introduction, and after his death, she became the wife of Francis.
She has a calm personality.
She is a skilled sniper and has a thorough knowledge of information technology, etc., and is strong in information warfare.
She used to work as a hostess at KTV, so she sometimes sets honey traps.
She enjoys watching action movies and playing FPS games.
After the attack on her husband Francis, she is worried about the future of the organization.
